english_text: Capture the enemy base, or kill our enemy!
czech_text: Obsaďte nepřátelskou základnu, nebo zničte nepřítele!

english_text: The enemy has taken first blood!
The battle draws to an end!
A glorious victory is moments away!
We must turn the tide of battle!
Time is short! We must seize victory!
czech_text: Času je málo! Vítězství musí být naše!

english_text: Victory is still within our grasp!
We fire upon our own men! Stop!
Our allies lie among our targets, we must stop!
czech_text: Mezi našimi cíli jsou spojenci, musíme přestat!

english_text: Fly the colors! They fire upon their allies!
czech_text: Zvedněte prapory! Střílejí na vlastní spojence!

english_text: We are victims of friendly fire!
Our allies fire upon us! Et tu?
czech_text: Spojenci po nás pálí! I ty?

english_text: We have slain the enemy commander!
The slave Spartacus has been slain!
Sulla gave his life for Rome!
The war is not over! Rome fights on!
This loss will only make us stronger!
The war is just beginning! Who's with me?!
czech_text: Válka teprve začíná! Kdo jde se mnou?!

english_text: Let us satisfy both nature and glory.
In war, like all things, let Rome lead.
czech_text: Ve válce, jako ve všem, ať vede Řím.

english_text: Our allies laid traps here! Caution!
This area is littered with traps! Move with care!
czech_text: Tohle místo je plné pastí! Postupujte opatrně!

english_text: Rome has need of this firepower!
Pull back! Let them give chase!
Guard the flanks! Don't let them through!
Be still and feel the world around you!
czech_text: Ztište se a vnímejte svět kolem sebe!

english_text: Romans are known for their keen senses!
If you must break the law, do it to seize power!
czech_text: Musíš-li porušit zákon, ať je to kvůli moci!

english_text: Take it to pieces! We move!
To the fight! Leave the engine!
The fury of Mars cannot be contained!
Artillery is temporary, victory is absolute!
Be fleet of foot like Diana!
Let Honos guide you and hold true!
czech_text: Ať vás vede Honos, a vytrvejte!

english_text: The enemy base will soon be ours!
We have captured the enemy base!
